title.narrative: Batchenga-Ntui-Yoko-Tibati-N’gaoundere Corridor Phase II: Construction of Ngatt-Febadi-Likok Road Section Project

description.narrative: The Project Development Objective (PDO) is to help open-up and develop the Centre and Adamaoua Regions of Cameroon by improving the level of road service between Batchenga and Ngaoundere, of which the Ngatt – Fibadi – Likok road is a critical link and thereby enhance the living conditions of the people of these regions. This objective is directly relevant to the problem statement, i.e. the poor condition and low level of service of the existing roads, which hinders the socio-economic development of the region and exposes road users to high risks of accidents and insecurity. The objective is also in line with the country's development objectives, which aim to promote regional integration, economic diversification and social inclusion through improved transports infrastructures and services to facilitate trade exchanges between Cameroon, Nigeria, Chad and the Central African Republic.
